foundations.above-t-1-one-characteristic.en: Above Δt = 1 one characteristic root grows. A smaller starting perturbation does not repair this instability.

foundations.amplitude-stays-one-to-round.en: Amplitude stays one to roundoff for this linear oscillator. A finite time step still changes the phase.

notebook.ssp-preserves-a-property-that-f.en: SSP preserves a property that forward Euler already has.

notebook.if-the-spatial-operator-has-the.en: If the spatial operator has the required convex stability property for h ≤ h_FE, an SSP method inherits it for h ≤ C h_FE. The letters SSP do not create positive states or repair an unsuitable flux. Classical RK4 can work well without having a general nonlinear SSP guarantee.
notebook.if-the-spatial-operator-has-the.ja: 空間作用素がh ≤ h_FEで必要な凸安定性を持つなら、SSP法はh ≤ C h_FEでそれを継承します。SSPという名称だけでは正値性は生まれず、不適切な流束も修復できません。古典RK4は一般的な非線形SSP保証がなくても良い結果を出せる場合があります。

notebook.ssprk-s-p-names-stages-then-ord.en: SSPRK(s,p) names stages then order. Embedded RK 5(4), low-storage RK, implicit RK, and IMEX are different branches, explained in the chapter. Adaptivity and embedded error estimates are not implemented here.
notebook.ssprk-s-p-names-stages-then-ord.ja: SSPRK(s,p)は段数、次数の順です。埋め込みRK 5(4)、低記憶RK、陰的RK、IMEXは別の分岐として本文で説明します。この実験では適応刻みと埋め込み誤差推定を実装していません。

notebook.one-rhs-evaluation-first-order-.ja: 右辺評価1回、1次精度です。SSP構成が安定性を継承する際の基準となるステップです。

notebook.heun-explicit-trapezoid-is-sspr.en: Heun / explicit trapezoid is SSPRK(2,2). Its two-stage RK2 siblings share its scalar stability polynomial, but have different nonlinear stages and SSP coefficients.
notebook.heun-explicit-trapezoid-is-sspr.ja: Heun／陽的台形則はSSPRK(2,2)です。他の2段RK2も同じスカラー安定多項式を持ちますが、非線形の段階値とSSP係数は異なります。

notebook.this-is-the-explicit-two-stage-.en: This is the explicit two-stage midpoint RK2 method, distinct from implicit midpoint. Its general nonlinear SSP coefficient is zero, despite sharing Heun’s linear stability polynomial.
notebook.this-is-the-explicit-two-stage-.ja: 陰的中点則とは異なる、陽的2段の中点RK2法です。Heunと線形安定多項式が同じでも、一般的な非線形SSP係数はゼロです。

notebook.a-two-stage-rk2-method-with-c-2.en: A two-stage RK2 method with c₂ = 2/3. Its general nonlinear SSP coefficient is 1/2. The same formal order and linear polynomial do not fix the nonlinear error.
notebook.a-two-stage-rk2-method-with-c-2.ja: c₂ = 2/3の2段RK2で、一般的な非線形SSP係数は1/2です。形式次数と線形多項式が同じでも非線形誤差は決まりません。

notebook.classical-three-stage-rk3-has-t.en: Classical three-stage RK3 has the same scalar stability polynomial as SSPRK(3,3), but a negative tableau entry and zero general nonlinear SSP coefficient.
notebook.classical-three-stage-rk3-has-t.ja: 古典3段RK3はSSPRK(3,3)と同じスカラー安定多項式を持ちますが、係数表に負の成分があり、一般的な非線形SSP係数はゼロです。

notebook.the-three-stage-third-order-shu.en: The three-stage, third-order Shu–Osher method. Its SSP coefficient C = 1 inherits the applicable forward-Euler property under h ≤ h_FE.
notebook.the-three-stage-third-order-shu.ja: 3段3次のShu–Osher法です。SSP係数C = 1で、h ≤ h_FEにおいて適用可能な前進Eulerの性質を継承します。

notebook.four-stages-third-order-c-2-all.en: Four stages, third order. C = 2 allows twice the applicable forward-Euler step, subject to the same spatial and stage-treatment premises. Stage times are not chronological.
notebook.four-stages-third-order-c-2-all.ja: 4段3次です。同じ空間作用素・段階処理の仮定のもとで、C = 2により適用可能な前進Euler刻みの2倍を許します。段階時刻は昇順ではありません。

notebook.classical-four-stage-fourth-ord.en: Classical four-stage, fourth-order RK4 has a useful scalar stability region, but C = 0 for the general nonlinear SSP property. This does not predict failure on every problem.
notebook.classical-four-stage-fourth-ord.ja: 古典4段4次RK4は有用なスカラー安定領域を持ちますが、一般的な非線形SSP係数はC = 0です。すべての問題で失敗するという意味ではありません。

notebook.five-stages-fourth-order-using-.en: Five stages, fourth order, using the Spiteri–Ruuth coefficients given in the SSP review. The conservative rounded bound C = 1.508 has been checked against the full tableau.
notebook.five-stages-fourth-order-using-.ja: SSP総説に掲載されたSpiteri–Ruuth係数を使う5段4次法です。安全側に丸めた限界C = 1.508を完全な係数表に対して確認しています。

gallery.dmr-field-note.en: 2D Mach-10 shock reflection on 256 × 64 cells. Open the saved-state movie; first-order HLL is a diffusive baseline.
gallery.dmr-field-note.ja: 256 × 64セルの2次元Mach 10衝撃波反射。保存状態の動画を開けます。1次HLLによる散逸的な基準計算です。

gallery.ct-field-note.en: 2D periodic MHD on 64 × 64 cells. CT uses a staggered magnetic field and its native face-divergence operator.
gallery.ct-field-note.ja: 64 × 64セルの2次元周期MHD。CTはスタガード磁場と対応する面発散演算子を使います。

gallery.glm-field-note.en: 2D periodic MHD on 64 × 64 cells. Inspect GLM time evolution; its cell-centered divergence is distinct from CT.
gallery.glm-field-note.ja: 64 × 64セルの2次元周期MHD。GLMの時間発展を確認できます。セル中心の発散はCTの演算子と異なります。

gallery.keep-field-note.en: 2D Euler vortex on 96 × 96 cells. Original Cartesian KEEP with RK4; smooth-flow test without shock stabilization.
gallery.keep-field-note.ja: 96 × 96セルの2次元Euler渦。原型の直交KEEPとRK4を使う滑らかな流れのテストで、衝撃波安定化は含みません。

gallery.fem-field-note.en: 2D P1 finite elements: computed solution and nodal error on 1152 triangles. Continuous L2/H1 errors use inside-element quadrature.
gallery.fem-field-note.ja: 1152三角形上の2次元P1有限要素解と節点誤差。連続的なL2・H1誤差は要素内部の求積で測ります。

gallery.mac-field-note.en: 2D periodic MAC projection on 64 × 64 cells. Velocity arrows are averaged to cell centers; diagnostics use native face velocities.
gallery.mac-field-note.ja: 64 × 64セルの2次元周期MAC射影。速度矢印はセル中心への平均で表示し、診断量には面上の速度を使います。

gallery.poisson3d-field-note.en: 3D periodic FFT Poisson on a 32 × 32 × 32 mesh, checked against one exact Fourier mode. Three orthogonal potential slices; no 3D fluid evolution.
gallery.poisson3d-field-note.ja: 32 × 32 × 32格子の3次元周期FFT Poisson解を、一つの厳密Fourierモードと照合。ポテンシャルの直交3断面で、3次元流体の時間発展ではありません。
